description:
INTUITIVE® is a nationally recognized Best Place to Work that provides solutions from design through production to sustainment by delivering targeted results. Our approach couples the latest technology with engineering expertise and analytical proficiency while remaining true to genuine customer relationships and a culture that fosters growth and opportunity. Our diverse portfolio of capabilities and extensive customer base allows our employees countless opportunities to pursue their passions and support our nation’s Warfighters. Join our team that encourages creativity, welcomes initiative, and seeks excellence. Start Building Your Future today!
 
 We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to support USSF in the development of a next‑generation satellite testbed environment. In this role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of both flight‑software‑representative applications and ground station software used to exercise, validate, and integrate space system behaviors. You will work within an advanced hardware‑in‑the‑loop flat‑satellite test configuration that simulates spacecraft functions.
 
 As part of a collaborative engineering team, you will participate across the software lifecycle—including requirements interpretation, architecture, implementation, integration, automated testing, and system troubleshooting. You will develop high‑reliability C software as your primary responsibility, with additional tasks in C++ and Python to support scripting, test automation, and tooling. You will regularly report progress and technical status to the software lead and contribute to a fast‑paced Agile environment focused on mission readiness. Strong communication, problem‑solving skills, and a commitment to quality are essential for success in this role. The salary range for this role is $110,000 to $175,000 annually. Final compensation for this position will be determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. This position is contingent upon contract award.
 
 Required 
 BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline
 5+ years of experience developing software in C/C++
 Experience with Python
 Experience working in Linux environments
 Experience applying software engineering and project tools (configuration control, CI/CD pipelines and workflows, etc.)
 Experience with software testing
 Knowledge of Scrum or other Agile methodologies
 Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance
 
 Desired 
 Experience with NASA Core Flight System (cFS)
 Experience with C2/telemetry systems 
 Experience with RTOS
 Experience with test harness development
 Knowledge of embedded communication protocols (e.g., UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, TCP/IP)
 Experience with Git
 Experience with MATLAB/Simulink
 Experience with Ansys STK
 Experience developing within hardware‑in‑the‑loop or system‑integration test environments
 
 Disability Accommodation for Applicants - Intuitive Research and Technology Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in its job application procedures. If you have any difficulty using our online system and you need an accommodation due to a disability, you may use the following alternative email address or phone number to contact us about your interest in employment at INTUITIVE   hr@irtc-hq.com  or 256-922-9300. Our process is to respond and to work with the requestor to identify a workable accommodation to the application process.
